title: 13. Who Will Be My Partner?
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Tomorrow we're going to the museum! Hold your partner's hand as we walk around. At Teacher Sheep's words, the Rainbow Class buzzed with excitement. Who will be my partner? Hori felt confident. I'll find one right away. No problem!
But something felt strange. Everyone crowded around Bori. Bori, be my partner! No, be mine! Bori was very popular. Hori went from friend to friend. Would you be my partner?
Toto said, Sorry, I already agreed to go with Kongi. Kongi shook their head, too. I'm going with Bori. Dubu already had a partner as well. One by one, everyone held hands, and Hori was left alone.
Hori's nose tingled. Why doesn't anyone want to be my partner? Everyone only likes Bori. His shoulders drooped, and he scuffed his toes. That thought went round and round in his head all day.

At home, Hori snuggled into Mom's arms. Mom, everyone only likes Bori. I couldn't even find a partner. Mom sat him on her lap and patted his back. You're feeling hurt, aren't you? Shall I tell you a story from long ago?
Long ago, two squirrels lived in a forest. One kept all the acorns and grumbled. The other helped friends who fell down and shared acorns, too. Hori's eyes grew wide, and his ears perked up.

A cold winter came. Friends gathered around the kind squirrel, sharing acorns and staying warm together. But the greedy squirrel was cold and all alone. Mom hugged Hori. Friends are drawn to kindness.

Hori thought carefully about that day. When Kongi fell, Bori had quickly helped. But Hori hadn't shared his blocks and had only looked after his own things. Bori was kind, but I wasn't. Hori's cheeks turned pink.
The next morning, Hori decided to change. When Dubu dropped crayons, he quickly picked them up. Here you go! He shared drawing paper with Kongi, too. Let's do it together! The friends smiled.
Near the end of playtime, the friends came to Hori. Hori, be my partner tomorrow! Be mine, too! Hori beamed, and his tail sparkled like a rainbow. Now he understood. Friends are drawn to kindness.
